title: Creating a ₹72 Lakh Pipeline for a Fintech SaaS Company
challenge: A fintech SaaS company wanted to sell into banks and financial institutions but faced long sales cycles, limited access to senior stakeholders and difficulty establishing trust.
solution: Myntmore built an account-based LinkedIn strategy targeting finance, technology, operations and digital transformation leaders. Founder content focused on regulatory awareness, operational efficiency and practical product applications.
results: Stronger visibility within target financial institutions.
